title: What can I do if my mortgage lender or servicer is charging me for force-placed homeowner's insurance?
claims: In many instances, this insurance protects only the lender, not you.
Force-placed insurance is usually more expensive than finding an insurance policy yourself.
A servicer may require force-placed coverage when the borrower does not have their own insurance policy or when the borrower's own policy does not meet the requirements of the mortgage contract.
A borrower should send proof of their own policy and any other information the servicer requested to the servicer and request that the servicer cancel the force-placed policy as soon as possible.
